hypothesis: Fix query-dependent sparse controls and rational zero-weight holes with one query-independent value at each lattice node. Motion improvement is unknown.
construction: Preserve each original observed-node mean. Each missing node is the unweighted mean of original observed-node means within Chebyshev radius three lattice steps, lexicographic neighbor order, with no cascading. Radius three follows from the four-control cubic support, rather than sequence outcomes. Evaluate ordinary tensor cubic basis and its analytic gradient. Thread-safe immutable-entry per-cell cache changes cost only.
coverage: Retain at least four original observed controls in the queried cubic support. Any missing control then has at least those four observations in its radius-three neighborhood. No quotient, weight-zero exclusion or epsilon. Count validity boundaries remain explicit; continuity claims apply only to both-valid neighboring cells, not global coverage.
scope: New default-false S2S-only s2s_intensity_consistent option. Mutually exclusive normalized/consistent options throw before estimator updates. Legacy, normalized and S2M definitions remain unchanged. Cache copy identity is preserved until either copy rebuilds; each build resets its own identity. Concurrent queries after build supported; concurrent build/eval of the same grid unsupported.
configuration: All inherited settings: plane check0.05, acceleration, mapped prediction, translation prior0.03, ground/facade PCA. In same-history probes only use_mapping=false after injecting prior extracted frame and original estimated initial seed. Never native GT input. Consensus profiles use the same source/previous cloud and seed for all six arms.
primary: Compare fixed-node joint4 to legacy joint0. Fixed-node consensus5 versus legacy consensus1 retains rescue/adverse controls only. Normalized2/3 are exact inherited negative controls; never choose arms after outcomes.
case_set: Every inherited old/01/02/08 endpoint, exact previous all/features, current features and estimated seed, including fallback controls. All 31 cases, all six arms; no filtering by new outcomes. Original8 are conditional reference histories, other23 are actual rejected-recursive-candidate histories.
field_set: Reuse every old continuity-audit synthetic and real path and query location. All original-valid reflector paths and all crossed faces, negative coordinates, within-cell differences and ULP-side samples. Reconstruct every native value/gradient and exact two-sided limits independently.
progression_gate: All native mechanism tests and exact four inherited whole traces pass. Every inherited field sample reconstructed; no both-valid intensity or gradient limit jump greater than1e-8, including all five previous zero-weight holes.
No newly bad length or vector label in either paired arm0/4 or1/5 on any inherited endpoint, using the inherited20% threshold.
Every original legacy-consensus rescue from a bad joint to non-bad length/vector remains non-bad with fixed-node consensus5.

Fixed-node joint4 strictly reduces both sums of absolute length-ratio error and vector error across the complete case set, and does not increase total rotation error. These conditional sums are feasibility controls, not trajectory scores.
failure_policy: Retain every outcome and all negative numeric cases; do not retune construction, thresholds, case set or gate. A failed progression gate prohibits a new full candidate run. If the gate passes, freeze one fixed-node joint setting and fresh paired full00-10 runs before any accuracy or paper-ratio claim.
history: Inherited profile07, diagnosis00, DiLO01-selected prior fraction0.03, and all subsequent KITTI studies informed development. New construction selected analytically from sparse representation defect, without new sequence tuning. Every prior KITTI observation is development; no held-out claim. Fixed-node radius is derived from cubic support; no new scale/threshold sweep.
old_evidence: All old raw archives, failures, numbers, source snapshots and independent verifiers remain unchanged. New measured sources are archived separately; inherited normalized and legacy traces must match exactly.
